vo.en: You can't lift your ring finger.

visual.description: A close-up of a man's hand placed firmly flat on a dark wooden desk.

vo.en: Put your hand flat on a table. Now, fold your middle finger all the way under so your knuckle touches the surface.

visual.description: Macro shot of a man folding his middle finger underneath his palm while other fingers remain straight.

vo.en: Try to lift your ring finger while keeping the others pinned. It's impossible. It feels like your brain just disconnected from your hand.

visual.description: The hand straining and twitching as the ring finger refuses to move upward.

vo.en: But here is the creepy part. Keep that position. Now, lift your index finger. Then, lift your pinky.

visual.description: The same hand easily lifting the index and pinky fingers while the middle finger stays tucked.

vo.en: They move perfectly, right? But the ring finger stays paralyzed. This happens because those two fingers share the exact same extensor tendon.

visual.description: A clean 3D medical animation showing the internal tendon structure of a human hand.

vo.en: It's a physical limitation of human anatomy. Your body literally locks itself when the middle finger is tucked.

visual.description: A heavy metal sliding bolt locking into place with a mechanical snap.

vo.en: Subscribe for tomorrow's brain test and comment GLITCH if this worked on you. It's wild because...

visual.description: A man looking at his hand with a look of pure shock and confusion.
